item.title: London Gets First Permanent Pokémon Store Outside Asia
item.description: Pokémon Company will open a permanent London store by 2029, the first outside Asia, offering exclusive merch and marking a new global retail milestone.

item.title: Polaroid’s Pokémon Collection: Instant Nostalgia Meets Tech
item.description: Polaroid’s new Pokémon-themed cameras and film merge retro instant photography with gaming nostalgia, launching October 5 after August 25 pre-orders.
